15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is __dynamically generated based on real-time server load metrics and is not merely stored application information__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker that evaluates the real-time server load metrics to determine optimal server selection__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request and uses the unique signature to identify server load information that was not previously embedded in the hyperlink itself__.

17. (Currently Amended) A system for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a client computer; a first set of one or more server computers; a second server computer; and a media request broker, wherein the client computer accesses a server computer through a path in a computer network including the one or more server computers, the media request broker adds information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being dynamically determined at the time of the client request rather than pre-stored__, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier, and the media request broker selects the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __by evaluating current server performance metrics at the time of selection__.

24. (Currently Amended) A system of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a client computer; a first set of one or more server computers; a second server computer; and a media request broker, wherein the client computer accesses a server computer through a path in a computer network including the one or more server computers, the media request broker adds information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being dynamically generated based on real-time conditions rather than merely reflecting pre-stored application information__, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier, and the media request broker selects the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

25. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker processes the http request and determines server selection based on the unique signature and real-time server load information not embedded in the hyperlink__.

27. (Currently Amended) A computer program product for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: a computer readable storage medium; program instructions stored on the computer readable storage medium, the program instructions comprising: instructions for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; instructions for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server conditions rather than pre-stored application information__; instructions for identifying the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and instructions for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker using real-time metrics__.

28. (Currently Amended) The computer program product of claim 27, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the computer program product further comprising the program step of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the program instructions further comprise instructions for the media request broker to receive the http request and determine server selection using the unique signature and real-time server load information__.
